title: Mung Bean Patties in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: sprouted mung beans with brown rice
description: Sprouted mung beans and brown rice are blended with coriander and spices, shaped into balls and baked. They simmer briefly in a spiced fresh tomato sauce. The beans must be sprouted a day ahead.

steps.text: Cook the sprouted mung beans for about 5 minutes, until slightly softened.
Place the beans, cooked rice, onion, coriander, garlic, olive oil and the spices in a food processor and blend to a uniform texture.
Shape into balls, place on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake in a preheated medium oven for about 20 minutes.
For the sauce, saute the onion and garlic in a wide pot (with water instead of oil), grate the tomatoes and add to the pot. Add 1 cup of water, the tomato paste, coriander and spices.
When the sauce is ready, add the baked patties to the pot and cook for about 2 minutes so the sauce soaks in.
